regime_context: Policy regime is a sequenced, inflation-gated low-real-yield campaign: Warsh's Fed is holding the hawkish line into a stagflationary split (hot PCE vs cracked payrolls), while Bessent runs structural yield suppression. The consensus still reads the Fed as purely hawkish; revealed interest is to bank credibility now and hold easing as optionality — so stagflation tail risks are being underpriced by front-end doves.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场分阶段、以通胀为闸门的低实际收益率行动：Warsh 领导的美联储在滞胀分化（PCE 偏热而就业走弱）中维持鹰派立场，而 Bessent 实施结构性收益率压制。市场共识仍把美联储单纯解读为鹰派；但真实偏好是先积累信誉、把宽松留作期权——因此前端的鸽派定价正在低估滞胀尾部风险。

theses.subject: XOP
theses.thesis: With the Iran ceasefire collapsed and US strikes underway, Brent has spiked toward $80, and a hike-majority market plus hot PCE sharpens the stagflationary split. XOP's higher-beta E&P leverage captures the upside oil shock while rates volatility caps large-cap tech, giving XOP a positive relative tilt vs SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 随着伊朗停火破裂、美军实施打击，Brent 一度冲高至 80 美元附近，叠加市场定价加息占多数以及 PCE 偏热，滞胀分化加剧。XOP 高贝塔的勘探开采杠杆可捕捉油价上行冲击，同时利率波动压制大盘科技股，使其相对 SPY 具备正向倾斜。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026; rotation is real and re-primed
May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y — highest since Oct-2023
theses.dissent: Any de-escalation or Hormuz calm could collapse the risk premium quickly, while XOP's realized hit rate in this desk's history is single-sample and energy remain headline-fragile.
theses.dissent_zh: 任何局势降级或霍尔木兹海峡恢复平静都可能迅速瓦解风险溢价，而本台历史中 XOP 的命中样本极少，能源板块对新闻高度敏感。

falsifier.text: XOP lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: XOP 在检查日前跑输 SPY 5%

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: Bessent's dealer-intermediation reform and eSLR-relaxation agenda are structural revenue and balance-sheet tailwinds for regional banks, and the manufactured strong-dollar plus front-end bill issuance keeps funding conditions orderly. KBE gets the policy-lift without the money-center rate-duration drag that hurt the earlier XLF call.
theses.thesis_zh: Bessent 的交易商中介改革和 eSLR 松绑议程为区域银行带来结构性的营收与资产负债表顺风，同时人为维持的强美元加上前端短债发行使融资条件保持有序。KBE 获得政策提振，又不承受此前 XLF 看多中大型银行所遭遇的利率久期拖累。
evidence: Rotation targeted: Financials / dealer banks — FACT mechanism, proxies XLF/KBE
Open prediction: concrete eSLR-reform progress from a banking regulator
Treasury keeps framing policy as keeping the risk-free rate low / affordability
theses.dissent: A September hike materializing at >70% market probability would steepen the curve and squeeze regional net-interest margins while credit risk rises with the labor crack — the exact setup that produced a recent KBE miss.
theses.dissent_zh: 若 9 月加息按市场逾 70% 的概率落地，收益率曲线将变陡，挤压区域银行净息差，同时就业走弱推升信用风险——这正是此前 KBE 看多失败的组合。

falsifier.text: KBE underperforms SPY by 4% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: KBE 在检查日前跑输 SPY 4%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force and the Section 301 replacement is pending — if the handoff completes cleanly after July 24, the strategic onshoring premium survives the SCOTUS strike-down. SMH captures the domestic-fab and advanced-packaging mandate that industrial policy keeps funding.
theses.thesis_zh: 25% 先进芯片关税仍然有效，且 Section 301 替代方案待定——若 7 月 24 日后交接顺利完成，SCOTUS 裁决不会消除战略本土化溢价。SMH 捕捉产业政策持续注资的本土晶圆厂与先进封装主线。
evidence: China theater: onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff completing cleanly
Rotation targeted: Domestic semiconductors / fabs — FACT mechanism
Open prediction: 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force and/or covered list expands
theses.dissent: Re-escalation in Iran plus a hike-majority Fed raises the discount rate on long-duration semiconductor earnings; a stalled Section 301 replacement or tariff rescission would unwind the protection premium quickly.
theses.dissent_zh: 伊朗局势再升级叠加市场定价加息占多数，会抬高长久期半导体盈利的贴现率；Section 301 替代方案停滞或关税撤销将迅速瓦解保护性溢价。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: SMH 在检查日前跑输 SPY 5%
